extDescription.message: Free, open-source recorder for capturing audio, video, or both from a single tab 100% locally. No cloud, no time limits.

formatHintMp3.message: Best compatibility (cars, players, mobile, PowerPoint). Compact size (~1.4 MB/min) with crash recovery.

formatHintMp4.message: Best for video: smooth playback, accurate colors, and wide compatibility (Windows, Mac, mobile, editors). No crash recovery.

formatHintWebmVideo.message: Smaller files with crash recovery — great for long recordings and web playback. Choose MP4 for sharing or editing.

formatHintWebmAudio.message: Smallest audio files: crisp Opus sound (~1 MB/min) with crash recovery. Choose MP3 for universal playback.

formatHintWav.message: Lossless audio for editing in audio tools — much larger files (~10 MB/min).

qualityHintStandard.message: Balanced quality up to 1080p — bitrate adapts automatically to resolution for smaller files.

qualityHintHigh.message: Native resolution for sharp text and colors — bitrate adapts automatically to frame or region size.

speakerTooltip.message: You will hear tab sound through your speakers while recording. Click to mute live playback (audio is still recorded).

speakerAriaMonitor.message: Tab audio monitoring enabled. Click to mute live playback.

speakerAriaMuted.message: Tab audio monitoring muted. Click to hear tab audio.

configSummaryAria.message: Active recording configuration: $SUMMARY$. Click to edit in settings.

menuRecordSmartRegionSub.message: Hover to pick a block, scroll wheel to change level

menuRecordRegionSub.message: Drag freely with the 8× pixel magnifier loupe

regionHintSmart.message: Click to select block · Wheel / ↑↓: change level · Drag: manual · Esc: cancel

regionHintDrag.message: Click and drag to select area · Press Esc to cancel

regionCoachStepHover.message: Hover over any video, card, table, or section to highlight it automatically.

regionCoachStepWheel.message: Scroll the mouse wheel or press ↑ / ↓ to expand or narrow the block level.

regionCoachStepClick.message: Click to lock the block (or drag right away for manual selection with loupe).

regionTooSmall.message: Selected area is too small (minimum 32 × 32 px). Drag a larger region.

statusTabClosedSaved.message: Recorded tab closed — download started automatically.

statusFormatFallback.message: Selected format was unavailable — recording in WebM.

errUnsupportedTab.message: Browser system pages (chrome:// or Web Store) cannot be recorded. Switch to a regular webpage and try again.

errInjectionFailed.message: Cannot open the region selector on this page. Check extension permissions for local files or record the full tab.

errNotInvoked.message: Click the WebTabRec icon in the toolbar on this tab to allow recording.

errTabAlreadyCaptured.message: This tab is already being recorded or shared by another tool.

errCaptureFailed.message: Could not start tab capture. Reload the tab and try again.

errAudioContextFailed.message: Could not initialize local audio playback. Try clicking the page or reloading the tab.

errQuotaExceeded.message: Browser storage is full. Recording was stopped and export was attempted.

errQuotaLowPrestart.message: Not enough free browser storage space to start recording. Free up space and try again.

errWavSizeLimit.message: WAV file size limit reached (~2 GB). Recording was safely stopped and prepared for download.

errWriteFailed.message: Failed to save recording data to local browser storage. Reload the page or free up space and try again.

errSaveFailed.message: Could not assemble or save the recording file. Dismiss this message and try recording again.

errRecoveryFailed.message: Could not recover the interrupted recording. You can try again or discard it.

errOffscreenLost.message: Background recorder stopped unexpectedly. Reopen the popup to check for recoverable data.

welcomeSubtitle.message: Record audio, video, or both from a single regular browser tab — 100% locally and free.

welcomeStep1Title.message: Open or pin WebTabRec on your toolbar

welcomeStep1Desc.message: Click the puzzle icon in the top-right corner to open WebTabRec anytime, or pin it for one-click access.

welcomeStep2Title.message: Switch to a regular webpage and pick a mode

welcomeStep2Desc.message: Open the tab you want to record and choose Audio, Video, or Both. Use the arrow next to Start Recording to pick a page block automatically or drag a manual region with the 8× loupe.

welcomeStep3Title.message: Click Start Recording, then Stop & Save

welcomeStep3Desc.message: You can close the popup or switch tabs anytime. When finished, click Stop & Save to download your file locally.

welcomeShortcutsIntro.message: Control recording directly from your keyboard in the active Chrome window without opening the popup.

welcomeShortcutsHelp.message: Chrome lets you assign or customize extension shortcuts at the address below — copy and paste it into the address bar:

welcomePrivacyPointLocal.message: Everything runs 100% inside your browser — zero cloud uploads, accounts, or tracking.

welcomePrivacyPointPerms.message: Minimal permissions scoped to a single tab; never reads your other tabs or browsing history.

welcomePrivacyPointFormats.message: Export MP3, MP4, WebM, or WAV locally with crash recovery and no time limits.

welcomeDrmNote.message: Note: Browser system pages (chrome://) and strict DRM streaming sites cannot be recorded due to browser security restrictions.
